May 19, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Trillium Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Wabtec Corp (WAB) by 7.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trillium Asset Management Llc bought 17,619 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.36% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 240,756 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.61M, up from 223,137 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trillium Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Wabtec Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.17 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.10% or $1.04 during the last trading session, reaching $95.19. About 412,225 shares traded. Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies Corporation (NYSE:WAB) has risen 7.58% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.97% the S&P500.
Gofen & Glossberg Llc decreased its stake in Teva Pharmaceutical Ind Adr (TEVA) by 55.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gofen & Glossberg Llc sold 22,071 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.04% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,804 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $337,000, down from 39,875 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gofen & Glossberg Llc who had been investing in Teva Pharmaceutical Ind Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.62B market cap company.
